cards.ex: I'm going to sound him out about the new policy before the meeting.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilishdan oldin uning yangi siyosatga qanday qarashini bilib olmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Birovning fikrini yoki munosabatini ehtiyotkorlik bilan so'rab bilish.

cards.ex: After a frank exchange of views, we reached a compromise.
cards.exUz: Ochiq fikr almashuvidan so'ng, biz kelishuvga erishdik.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq, to'g'ri va samimiy fikr almashuvi.

cards.ex: I had to lay it on the line with him about his performance.
cards.exUz: Men unga uning ish faoliyati haqida rostini aytishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va to'g'ri gapirmoq, hech narsani yashirmasdan.

cards.ex: He was spinning a yarn about his adventures in the Amazon.
cards.exUz: U Amazonkadagi sarguzashtlari haqida ertak to'qirdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq va qiziqarli, lekin ko'pincha haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan hikoya aytmoq.

cards.ex: It's time for them to bury the hatchet and move on.
cards.exUz: Ularning janjalni tugatib, oldinga siljish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Janjal yoki dushmanlikni tugatib, yarashmoq.

cards.ex: Many residents have voiced concerns about the new development.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab aholi yangi qurilish bo'yicha o'z xavotirlarini bildirishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xavotirlarini yoki noroziliklarini ifoda etmoq.

cards.ex: He's a good speaker, he really knows how to get his point across.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi notiq, u o'z fikrini qanday qilib yetkazishni biladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini tushunarli va samarali tarzda boshqalarga yetkazmoq.

cards.ex: Can I have a word with you in private?
cards.exUz: Siz bilan shaxsiy gaplashib olsam maylimi?
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan shaxsiy gaplashmoq, maslahatlashmoq.

cards.ex: I think I touched a nerve when I mentioned his divorce.
cards.exUz: O'ylashimcha, men uning ajrashishini aytganimda, uning dardini qo'zg'atdim.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir sezgir nuqtasiga tegib, uni xafa qilmoq yoki g'azablantirmoq.

cards.ex: His comments were easily misconstrued in that context.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlari o'sha vaziyatda osongina noto'g'ri talqin qilinishi mumkin edi.
cards.uzDef: Gap yoki harakatlar noto'g'ri talqin qilinishi.

cards.ex: Let's keep this project under wraps until we're ready to launch.
cards.exUz: Keling, ushbu loyihani ishga tushirishga tayyor bo'lgunimizcha sir saqlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni sir saqlamoq, uni oshkor qilmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm finally starting to get a handle on this new software.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat ushbu yangi dasturni tushunishni boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish yoki nazorat qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: Investigating this case could open a real can of worms.
cards.exUz: Ushbu ishni tekshirish haqiqiy muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yechimi qiyin bo'lgan yangi muammolarni keltirib chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: Don't be afraid to speak your mind in the meeting.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilishda o'z fikringizni aytishdan qo'rqmang.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini, hatto boshqalarga yoqmasa ham, ochiq aytish.

cards.ex: I'll describe the plan in broad strokes for now.
cards.exUz: Men hozircha rejalarni umumiy tarzda tasvirlab beraman.
cards.uzDef: Batafsil emas, balki umumiy ma'noda.

cards.ex: I'm not sure what he was driving at with those comments.
cards.exUz: Ushbu izohlar bilan u nimani nazarda tutganiga amin emasman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida bilvosita gapirish, maqsadni yashirish.

cards.ex: I didn't understand all the details, but I got the gist of it.
cards.exUz: Men barcha tafsilotlarni tushunmadim, lekin asosiy mazmunini tushundim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning asosiy mazmuni yoki mohiyati.

cards.ex: We need to make sure everyone is on the same page before we start.
cards.exUz: Boshlashdan oldin hammamiz bir xil fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bitta narsani tushunish, bir xil fikrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Please keep me in the loop regarding any updates on the project.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, loyihaning yangilanishlari haqida meni xabardor qilib turing.
cards.term: to be kept in the loop
cards.uzDef: Voqealar, yangiliklar haqida xabardor bo'lib turmoq.

cards.ex: I'll touch base with you next week to discuss the details.
cards.exUz: Tafsilotlarni muhokama qilish uchun keyingi hafta siz bilan bog'lanaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan qisqacha bog'lanib, xabar almashmoq.

cards.ex: The company is expected to make a statement later today.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bugunroq bayonot berishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy yoki jamoat oldida fikr bildirish.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to increase sales.
cards.exUz: Asosiy mohiyat shundaki, biz sotuvni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mohiyat, eng muhim fakt yoki xulosa.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what he really thinks.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nima deb o'ylashini tushunish uchun pinhon ma'noni anglashga harakat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aytilmagan narsalarni tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's good at getting his ideas across in presentations.
cards.exUz: U taqdimotlarda o'z g'oyalarini tushuntirib berishda yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Fikringizni boshqalarga tushunarli qilib yetkazish.

cards.ex: I heard it on the grapevine that she's leaving the company.
cards.exUz: Men mish-mishlardan uning kompaniyani tark etayotganini eshitib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan manbalardan, mish-mishlar orqali eshitish.

cards.ex: Using visuals can help you get your message across more effectively.
cards.exUz: Vizual materiallardan foydalanish sizga xabaringizni yanada samaraliroq yetkazishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xabaringizni tushunarli va samarali tarzda yetkazish.

cards.ex: Their dinner parties often involved lively verbal sparring; they just loved arguing.
cards.exUz: Ularning kechki ovqatlari ko'pincha qizg'in og'zaki bahslarni o'z ichiga olardi; ular shunchaki bahslashishni yaxshi ko'rishardi.
cards.uzDef: Og'zaki bahs, ayniqsa, aqlli va qiziqarli usulda. Odatda hazilomuz.

cards.ex: I tried to understand quantum physics, but it's still a closed book to me.
cards.exUz: Men kvant fizikasini tushunishga harakat qildim, lekin u hali ham men uchun sirli.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish qiyin bo'lgan narsa yoki odam, sirli.

cards.ex: The grapevine has it that the company is planning a major restructuring.
cards.exUz: Mish-mishlarga ko'ra, kompaniya katta qayta qurishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mish-mishlarga ko'ra, rasman tasdiqlanmagan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: I managed to talk him down from making a rash decision.
cards.exUz: Men uni shoshilinch qaror qabul qilishdan qaytarishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qandaydir ishdan qaytarmoq, ayniqsa, xato yoki xavfli ishdan.
